title: Ledup about with light switches
description: A centred label, headline, short paragraph and outline pill button over a wide photo with a pale switch bar under it: a row of five pill switches, each lighting one zone of the scene. As it comes up the window the photo and bar grow from 70% to full width (scrubbed with the scroll) and the switches fade in last. Text rises 24px into view.
notes: the photo is 390×450 on phones and 2:1 full-bleed on desktop (cover); empty shows a muted placeholder
each zone can carry its own lit layer (a photo of the scene with that zone on) that fades in when switched on; empty zones show a soft glow wash over their part of the frame
the switches need JavaScript (hydrate: visible); the grow and fade are CSS scroll-driven and off under reduced motion
